provenance.composite_rule: DESIGN (rule drafted 2026-10-14 by the analyst; a smoke run on the preliminary core rows available during implementation was made; amended 2026-10-14 after code review to rank by the oriented AUC so the a priori directions of metrics.direction are respected; to be confirmed by the PI): candidates = the pool predictors without missing or constant values on the training rows and with an oriented univariable AUC >= min_discrimination on the training rows (the AUC of direction x value with the direction of metrics.direction; 'core' directions are set on the training rows of every fold or resample, i.e. max(AUC, 1 - AUC)), so that the model is not filled with uninformative predictors and a predictor associated with the opposite of its a priori sign cannot enter; ranked by that oriented AUC (ties: list order); taken in rank order, skipping any candidate with |Spearman rho| > max_abs_spearman against one already chosen, up to max_predictors (study plan: <= 3; fewer if the candidates run out); L2-penalised logistic regression (logistic_C) on the z-scored selected predictors; the index is the model log-odds; selected predictors whose fitted coefficient sign opposes their direction are reported. The training rows are the core set; the rule is re-applied inside every LOOCV fold and bootstrap resample, and the hold-out set is never used for a choice.
provenance.incremental: DESIGN: geometry-only model = penalised logistic regression on the descriptors of the core design factors (arc, thickness, depth, deposit count); geometry + mechanics model = the same descriptors plus the mechanics predictors chosen by the composite rule. Compared by apparent AUC (paired bootstrap with both models refitted in every resample), LOOCV AUC, log-loss and Brier score (paired bootstrap of the out-of-fold predictions) and on the hold-out set (paired bootstrap of the hold-out rows).
provenance.direction: DESIGN: expected sign of the association with damage (+1: a higher value predicts damage and an earlier onset; -1: a lower value does). Stress, energy, area-fraction and edge-concentration predictors, the calcium arc and the Fujino score (higher = more severe calcification) +1; thinner calcium where the stress is high, thinner and more superficial calcium -1. 'core': no sign stated a priori; set on the core set as the sign giving AUC >= 0.5 (reported per predictor as direction_source 'core'; optimistic; univariable analyses: re-derived inside each LOOCV fold, kept fixed in the bootstrap; composite selection: re-derived on the training rows of every fold and resample). The directions apply to the damage outcomes (fracture yes/no, damage-onset load); stent expansion has no a priori direction (metrics.outcomes).
provenance.outcomes: DESIGN: D10 primary outcome = through-thickness damage under IVL (rows with ivl_status ok). Secondary: IVL damage-onset load (D10 'damage-onset pressure': lumen pressure, MPa, at the first load step with max d >= fracture.d_crack in the calcium, a local criterion; event: onset_recorded = the onset load is recorded, value = that load, so a partial crack without through-thickness damage is an event; otherwise right-censored at the lesion's own peak IVL pressure ivl_p_top as stored by its IVL run, the largest load the lesion saw, checked against p_bal + T_equivalent x ivl_peak_pressure_MPa x ivl_pulse_scale and recomputed from these only where ivl_p_top is absent; T enters only this censoring value, never a predictor; fracture_column is read only to count onset rows without through-thickness damage, which stay events), fracture under the 4 atm IVL balloon alone and under the 10 atm plain balloon, stent expansion with and without prior IVL (status 'limited' = pressure-limited expansion, kept; 'failed' runs excluded; no direction stated a priori, so these concordance analyses are exploratory: C of the raw predictor, its observed sign and max(C, 1 - C)). Logistic models (composite, incremental value) only where models is true. Amended 2026-10-14 after code review: the event was through-thickness damage while the value was the local onset load (two definitions); stent expansion had reused the damage directions of metrics.direction. Cross-model check (added 2026-10-14, before its result was seen): through-thickness fracture under IVL from the erosion comparator (D13, design.erosion_subset), a fracture model separate from the phase field, scored with the same pre-treatment predictors (univariable analyses only; few lesions, so interpret as a robustness check).

wording: Hold-out results evaluate core-derived thresholds and models, unchanged, on lesions not used for any choice; agreement is reported as consistency. All outcomes are simulated (in silico); no comparison with patients is made here.

ivl_fracture.univariable_ranking_by: core AUC of direction x value (direction_source 'core': sign set on the core set, AUC >= 0.5 by construction)

composite.name: LIFT
composite.rule: DESIGN (rule drafted 2026-10-14 by the analyst; a smoke run on the preliminary core rows available during implementation was made; amended 2026-10-14 after code review to rank by the oriented AUC so the a priori directions of metrics.direction are respected; to be confirmed by the PI): candidates = the pool predictors without missing or constant values on the training rows and with an oriented univariable AUC >= min_discrimination on the training rows (the AUC of direction x value with the direction of metrics.direction; 'core' directions are set on the training rows of every fold or resample, i.e. max(AUC, 1 - AUC)), so that the model is not filled with uninformative predictors and a predictor associated with the opposite of its a priori sign cannot enter; ranked by that oriented AUC (ties: list order); taken in rank order, skipping any candidate with |Spearman rho| > max_abs_spearman against one already chosen, up to max_predictors (study plan: <= 3; fewer if the candidates run out); L2-penalised logistic regression (logistic_C) on the z-scored selected predictors; the index is the model log-odds; selected predictors whose fitted coefficient sign opposes their direction are reported. The training rows are the core set; the rule is re-applied inside every LOOCV fold and bootstrap resample, and the hold-out set is never used for a choice.
composite.index_definition: log-odds = intercept + sum_k coef_per_sd[k] * (x_k - mean[k]) / sd[k]; probability = 1 / (1 + exp(-log-odds))

post_hoc.note: POST HOC (added 2026-10-15 after the draft review, with the outcomes known; D18): sensitivity of the Fujino comparison to the arc cut-off (the label map measures the 180 deg design arc as 179 deg, just below the strict '> 180 deg' criterion: an arc within FUJINO_ARC_TOL_DEG below a cut-off is counted as meeting it), and core AUCs without the core geometries of the pilot lesions used for the calcium-modulus calibration (D8); an outcome-criterion benchmark (linear failure index at the IVL peak load); and a flexible geometry model with a penalty sensitivity of the logistic models

outcome_criterion_benchmark.definition: pred_sigma1_peak_nl x ivl_p_top / pred_p_lumen_MPa / sigma_crit (sigma_crit = E_Ca eps_f)

ivl_onset.convention: Harrell's C: probability that, of two comparable lesions, the one with the higher oriented predictor (a priori direction x value; 'core' directions set on the core set, flagged) has the earlier onset. Event = local damage onset recorded (first load with max d >= fracture.d_crack; a partial crack without through-thickness damage is an event), value = the onset load (the peak load ivl_p_top for an onset after the peak, as in stage_sensitivity); no onset = right-censored at the lesion's own ivl_p_top. observed_sign = direction x sign(C - 0.5): +1 when a higher raw predictor value went with the earlier onset, -1 when a lower one did
ivl_onset.censoring: DESIGN: D10 primary outcome = through-thickness damage under IVL (rows with ivl_status ok). Secondary: IVL damage-onset load (D10 'damage-onset pressure': lumen pressure, MPa, at the first load step with max d >= fracture.d_crack in the calcium, a local criterion; event: onset_recorded = the onset load is recorded, value = that load, so a partial crack without through-thickness damage is an event; otherwise right-censored at the lesion's own peak IVL pressure ivl_p_top as stored by its IVL run, the largest load the lesion saw, checked against p_bal + T_equivalent x ivl_peak_pressure_MPa x ivl_pulse_scale and recomputed from these only where ivl_p_top is absent; T enters only this censoring value, never a predictor; fracture_column is read only to count onset rows without through-thickness damage, which stay events), fracture under the 4 atm IVL balloon alone and under the 10 atm plain balloon, stent expansion with and without prior IVL (status 'limited' = pressure-limited expansion, kept; 'failed' runs excluded; no direction stated a priori, so these concordance analyses are exploratory: C of the raw predictor, its observed sign and max(C, 1 - C)). Logistic models (composite, incremental value) only where models is true. Amended 2026-10-14 after code review: the event was through-thickness damage while the value was the local onset load (two definitions); stent expansion had reused the damage directions of metrics.direction. Cross-model check (added 2026-10-14, before its result was seen): through-thickness fracture under IVL from the erosion comparator (D13, design.erosion_subset), a fracture model separate from the phase field, scored with the same pre-treatment predictors (univariable analyses only; few lesions, so interpret as a robustness check).
